# Penguin Academy - Web Content Summary

Penguin Academy provides SSI swim teacher education in Singapore. Training is led by Remus Teo, an active SSI Swim Teacher Instructor and React Right Instructor Trainer (SSI Pro 121320).

Contact: swim@penguinswimschool.sg | WhatsApp +65 8909 4395 | https://wa.me/6589094395

## Courses and prices (SGD)

- Penguin Pro Bundle: any 2 teacher courses for $2,888 (usual combined price $3,376; save $488)
- SSI Swim Teacher Level 1: $1,688
- SSI Swim Teacher Level 2: $1,688
- SSI Baby & Me Swim Teacher: $1,688
- SSI Adult Swim Teacher: $1,688
- Full SSI React Right standalone: $100

Every $1,688 teacher course and the $2,888 bundle includes full SSI React Right: First Aid & CPR, AED Provider and Oxygen Provider.

## Delivery and completion

Each teacher course includes one instructor-led training day from 9am to 6pm. This is not the complete certification duration. Candidates must complete SSI digital learning, the Candidate Water Fitness Evaluation where required, theory and practical assessments, a final exam, and the programme-specific supervised apprenticeship before certification is issued.

- Level 1: SSI recommends 24-28 hours; apprenticeship includes 4 Aquatike and 4 Beginner lessons (recommended cumulative 4 hours).
- Level 2: SSI Level 1 certification required; SSI recommends 23-27 hours; apprenticeship includes 4 Intermediate and 2 Advanced lessons (recommended cumulative 3 hours).
- Baby & Me: SSI recommends 8-10 hours; apprenticeship includes 2 Baby Swim 1 and 2 Baby Swim 2 lessons (cumulative 2 hours).
- Adult: SSI recommends 22-26 hours, or 6-8 hours for qualified Level 2 teachers; apprenticeship includes 1 Adult 1 and 1 Adult 2 lesson (cumulative 2 hours).
- React Right: minimum age 12; SSI recommends 8-12 hours for the full combination; certification is valid for 2 years and does not require a swim-teaching apprenticeship.

Class size is 1-8 students. Venue is CBD / Central Singapore. Dates are flexible by arrangement; confirmed dates are shown when available. Enquiries and bookings are handled through WhatsApp.

Related organisation: Penguin Swim School, https://www.penguinswimschool.sg.
